title: Mai's English Recipe Adventure
keywords: học tiếng Anh qua truyện ngắn
segments: It was a sunny Saturday morning in Mai's cozy kitchen. Mai wanted to cook a special dish for her family: nem rán. She found an exciting English recipe online and was eager to try it. This was a perfect chance to practice her new language skills! She opened her tablet, ready to follow the instructions step-by-step.

Then, Mai tapped the screen to open the nem rán recipe. Suddenly, a new page appeared. It was a login screen! It asked for her username and password, then something called ‘two-factor authentication.’ The English instructions were long and confusing. Mai frowned. She really wanted to start cooking, but this was a tricky problem.

Because of this confusing login screen, Mai felt very frustrated. She really wanted to cook her nem rán. She knew her younger brother, Linh, was good with technology and English. He was in the living room playing a game. Mai walked over to him. "Linh," she said, "can you please help me understand this security message on my tablet?

After that, Linh looked at the tablet. 'This is two-factor authentication, Mai,' he explained patiently. 'The website sends a special code to your phone. We type it here to log in.' Mai nodded, trying to understand. Linh helped her find the code and carefully input it. Finally, the English recipe page opened! Mai smiled.

After that, Mai looked at the English recipe for nem rán. It had many new words. Linh pointed to the ingredients list. 'First, we need rice paper and pork,' he said, reading aloud. Mai felt excited. She was ready to cook and learn. Together, they started preparing the ingredients, discussing each step in English.

After that, Mai and Linh worked together, following the English recipe carefully. They chopped vegetables, mixed ingredients, and rolled the nem rán. Linh helped Mai with new cooking terms, and Mai practiced speaking. Soon, the kitchen filled with a delicious smell. Finally, the nem rán was ready! Their family loved the special dish.
endWrap: Mai's recipe adventure ended with a delicious meal and stronger English skills. She learned that challenges can be fun with help and practice.
